scope: Pure native/MCP/A2A-labelled adapter-profile projections into one canonical AXIOM request candidate and A2 requestability snapshot. This is not external wire-protocol conformance and creates no runtime authority.
core_invariant: Native AXIOM semantics are authoritative. Protocol profiles and metadata are inert translation/provenance inputs; changing protocol, profile metadata, discovery output, reputation, model brand or remote completion cannot widen authority.

risks: same external-looking action maps to broader AXIOM action
controls: every profile maps to canonical AXIOM action IDs
canonical request digest excludes protocol metadata
parity comparator fails if canonical request changes
A2 requestability is re-evaluated after mapping

risks: rewrite external ID to dangerous action
present a different profile as equivalent
controls: expected profile digest required for evaluation/discovery/result projection
metadata is provenance-digested but excluded from canonical request

risks: protocol principal differs from authority manifest
controls: protocol principal ID must equal A2 principal
protocol credential digest must equal A2 identity binding

risks: tools/list or Agent Card equivalent grants authority
disabled action becomes callable because advertised
controls: discovery projects only current A2 requestable mappings

risks: remote completion treated as verified local fact
source identity claim treated as verified
controls: external result projection preserves source/profile/result digests

risks: laboratory label presented as actual MCP/A2A conformance
projection parity presented as full runtime authority parity

known_nonclaims: A9a does not implement an MCP server/client wire protocol.
A9a does not implement an A2A endpoint or Agent Card conformance.
A9a proves A2 requestability-snapshot parity only, not full live effect authorization parity.
A9a does not authenticate external result source identity by itself.
A9a does not grant authority from discovery, reputation, profile metadata or protocol compatibility.
A9a performs no network effect and modifies no production adapter path.

implement one read-only MCP edge adapter against a pinned external protocol version
implement one read-only A2A edge adapter against a pinned external protocol version
